ADC ADS1115 (0x48 @ 860 SPS)

• A1: Sonda pH Dedicada (Po)
• A2: Shunt Rama 1 VCSS (0-3.53V)
• A3: Shunt Rama 2 VCSS (0-3.53V)

DAC MCP4725 (0x60 @ 12-bit)
• Consigna VCSS: 0.00V a 3.53V
• Resolucion: 4096 pasos (~0.86 mV)
• Gm = 2.0 S (I_nom: 0 a 7.06A)

• Corte Fisico Simultaneo de (+) y (-)
